writing.q: Some people believe that smartphones have made face-to-face communication worse. Do you agree?
A number of universities now offer full degree courses online. Do the benefits of studying online outweigh the drawbacks?
Some governments encourage people to use bicycles instead of cars in city centres. Do you think this is an effective way to protect the environment?
Many people today do not get enough sleep because of work and entertainment. Whose responsibility is it to solve this problem?
Some employers now value practical experience more than university degrees. Do you think this is a positive change?
In many families, both parents now work full time. Do you think this is a good development for children?
Some people prefer to save money for the future, while others prefer to spend it and enjoy the present. Which approach do you think is better?
Tourism brings money to many countries but can also damage local culture. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
Many people now watch films and TV shows on their phones rather than at the cinema. Do you think this is a positive trend?
Some parents reward their children with money for good exam results. Do you think this is a good idea?
In some workplaces, employees are encouraged to take short breaks to rest during the day. Do you think this improves productivity?
Some people believe that public libraries are no longer necessary because information is available online. To what extent do you agree?

vocab.ex: ~ state-of-the-art — “The lab uses cutting-edge technology.”
Smartphones can reduce face-to-face communication within families.
Some people chase money at the expense of their health.
For busy adults, online study is a viable alternative to classes.
~ limit, restrict — “Bike lanes help curb traffic in the city centre.”
Practical experience makes a graduate more well-rounded.
Parents can instil good sleeping habits in their children.
A part-time job gives teenagers a sense of independence.
Mass tourism can dilute a region's local culture.

vocab.d: sống trong khả năng tài chính
vocab.ex: People who live within their means rarely fall into debt.
Working from home has had far-reaching effects on city life.
Long working hours put a strain on family relationships.
Online courses are readily available to anyone with internet.
The income from tourism can offset the cost of preserving heritage sites.
For many workers, work-life balance is now a top priority.
>< a lasting change — “Watching films on phones is not just a passing trend.”
~ encourage creativity — “Free play helps foster creativity in children.”

vocab.d: trong tầm tay, sẵn có ngay
vocab.ex: The internet puts a world of information at your fingertips.
>< beneficial to — “Too much screen time can be detrimental to sleep.”
Workers who rest well reap the benefits of higher productivity.

vocab.d: phương tiện để đạt mục đích
vocab.ex: For some students, money is a means to an end, not a goal in itself.
